title: Skull Pick
description:
Skull Pick Tool by 7th floor is both handy as well as attractive. Each skull pick is hand crafted out of bright eye catching glass.
The skull picks have a small blade ground into one end of the pick.
Also please note that just about every skull pick has one eye that is not blacked out.
Included
1 x Skull Pick
